response.sql: WITH per_event_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS overall_average FROM per_event_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.average_budgeted_amount, p.average_budgeted_amount - o.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, p.average_budgeted_amount / o.overall_average AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_event_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.overall_average;

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL event_name form one group, following SQL GROUP BY behavior.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude events without a name from both the results and the overall average.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_event_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.event_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS overall_average FROM per_event_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.average_budgeted_amount, p.average_budgeted_amount - o.overall_average AS difference_from_overall, p.average_budgeted_amount / o.overall_average AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_event_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.overall_average;
